annotations.label: T cells (CD4-like memory/activated; IL7R+ AQP3+)
annotations.notes: Computed: IL7R (78% vs 32%), LTB, AQP3, TNFRSF4, CD40LG, CD2, CD3D and CD3E are enriched. S100A4 is detected in 94%. CD4 is detected in 15%, and CD8A in 5%. CD4-like memory is an inference. Abstracts support CD3D/CD3E/CD2 only, not IL7R, AQP3 or CD40LG.

annotations.label: T cells (naive-like, CCR7+ LDHB+; CD4/CD8 split unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: LDHB and CCR7 (52% vs 13%) are enriched, with ribosomal genes. CD3D is detected in 88% and CD3E in 78%. SELL is detected in 66%, CD8B in 26% and CD4 in 7%. Naive-like is an inference. CD3D/CD3E did not differ from cluster 0. Abstracts support CD3D/CD3E only, not CCR7 or LDHB.

annotations.label: B cells (naive-like features)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A (94% vs 4%), MS4A1, CD79B, TCL1A, BANK1 and VPREB3 are strongly enriched, with MHC class II genes. FCER2 is also enriched. Naive-like is an inference, not tested. PMID 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but only in a CLL case. Distinct UMAP island.

annotations.label: CD8+ effector/memory-like cytotoxic T cells (GZMK+)
annotations.notes: Computed: NKG7, CCL5, GZMA, GZMK, CST7, CD8A, CD8B and GZMH are enriched. CD3D is detected in 85%. KLRF1 is detected in 4.5% and NCAM1 in 0.3%, so NK cells are unlikely to dominate. Abstracts support NKG7/granzymes/CD8A as cytotoxic or T-cell genes, not GZMK or CCL5.

annotations.label: CD14+ classical monocytes (S100-high)
annotations.notes: Computed: S100A8, S100A9, LGALS2, FCN1, LYZ and CD14 (59% vs 10%) are enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 6%. Versus cluster 5, S100A8/S100A9/S100A12 are higher and HLA class II is lower. Abstracts support CD14+ monocytes and S100A8/S100A9, not LGALS2 or FCN1.

annotations.label: CD14+ monocytes (HLA-DR/CD68-high; classical vs intermediate unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD14 (73% vs 9%), LGALS2, FCN1, MS4A6A, S100A8 and CD68 are enriched. Versus cluster 4, HLA class II and CD68 are higher and S100A8/S100A9 lower. FCGR3A is detected in 24% and CLEC10A in 12%. Subset is unresolved. Abstracts support CD14+ monocytes, not CD68 or MS4A6A.

annotations.label: T cells (ribosomal-gene-high, low-complexity; subtype unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: top markers are mostly ribosomal genes and MALAT1. CD3D (78%) and IL32 are enriched. CD3E is detected in 61%. Median genes are 590, the lowest of any cluster. Versus cluster 1, CCL5, GZMK and NKG7 are higher. Library-size or low-RNA effects may contribute. No CD4/CD8 call. Abstracts support CD3D only.

annotations.label: FCGR3A+ (CD16+) non-classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: FCGR3A (96% vs 14%), MS4A7, CDKN1C, HES4, LILRA3, CSF1R and LST1 are enriched. CD14 is detected in 17%, versus 59–73% in clusters 4 and 5. Cytotoxic genes are low, which argues against NK cells. Abstracts support FCGR3A+ and CD16-high monocytes, not MS4A7, CDKN1C or LILRA3.

annotations.label: NK cells (CD16+ cytotoxic)
annotations.notes: Computed: GZMB, FGFBP2, SPON2, PRF1, GNLY, KLRD1 and NKG7 (100% of cells) are strongly enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 89% and KLRF1 in 27%. CD3D is detected in 8% and CD4 in 0%, which favors NK over T cells. NCAM1 is low (7%). Abstracts support GNLY/NKG7/GZMB/PRF1 as cytotoxic genes.

annotations.label: Dendritic cells (CD1C+ cDC-like; pDC admixture possible)
annotations.notes: Computed: FCER1A (83% vs 1%), CLEC10A, CD1C and SERPINF1 are enriched in 36 cells. HLA-DRA is detected in 100%. CLEC4C, LILRA4 and IL3RA are detected in 11–17%, so pDCs may be mixed in. Support is limited to a tumor scRNA abstract (38582791) and iPSC-derived cDC2 cells (35101945). Partial overlap.

annotations.label: Platelets or platelet-like cells (very small cluster)
annotations.notes: Computed: GP9 (90% vs 0.1%), ITGA2B, TREML1, LY6G6F, ITGB3 and GP1BA are enriched in only 10 cells. Median genes are 550. Abstracts support GP9 and ITGA2B as platelet genes, but only in non-PBMC contexts. PBMC-specific support was not retrieved. Small n and possible fragments, so tentative.
